name: 75211 · Dallas, TX
findings: ZIP 75211 (Dallas) has 78 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75211 (Dallas) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 75211 (Dallas) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 30% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 43 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
